pages.title: Celestial Ritual
pages.text: Celestial Ritual channels energy from nearby Celestial Blooms through the Ritual Table. Each recipe requires a catalyst, salted offering Braziers, and nearby Blooms.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: Celestial Ritual requires a $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_table)Ritual Table$(/l), selected salted Braziers, and the recipe's required number of nearby $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#celestial_bloom)Celestial Blooms$(/l). It must be night; sky exposure is not required.

pages.title: Process
pages.text: Place the catalyst on the Table and offerings on salted Braziers, then activate the ritual with a Hex Focus. The ritual draws energy from selected Blooms after the offerings move.

pages.title: Transformation
pages.text: After the ritual succeeds, selected Celestial Blooms wither and selected Withered Blooms become dead bushes. The catalyst transforms at the Ritual Table.

pages.title: On Use
pages.text: Each Celestial recipe shows its Bloom requirement separately from Brazier offerings. The Blooms are charged only when the ritual succeeds.
